purpose: NEVORA Employee/Owner native staging with fictional data only

hosting.protection: Protect generated deployments; one explicitly approved canonical-domain exception for the native probe/login and future public association metadata. Server sessions/authorization remain mandatory for all private data.
hosting.firstDeploymentPolicy: Inspect Vercel first-deployment behavior before any application deploy. If a new-project Production bootstrap is required, it must be a separate inert artifact with no application code, database or secrets. Obtain explicit approval for that bootstrap. Never place staging secrets in Production to work around it.

database.initializeFrom: new empty root; never clone production or Clocker
database.bootstrapRole: Separate temporary schema installer; never bind it to the web app
database.runtimeRole: Separate non-admin app login; only schema usage and required DML/function/sequence access, no schema CREATE/owner/role administration

data.passwords: Generate unique random credentials only after provisioning, store in owner private credential custody, never reuse public fixture passwords

native.associations: Pending actual installed-app signing identities and active Apple organization team; publish no placeholder associations

costProposal.notes: About $0.30 compute/storage before other metering/tax under the proposed quota; request $1 Neon budget headroom. No claim that Vercel spend alerts are a hard cap on custom/Preview deployments. No extra seats, trials, add-ons, team-wide changes to existing projects or automatic top-up.
